---
title: "Sovereign Wealth Funds"
date: "2007-08-10"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

The Peterson Institute’s [Ed Truman](http://news.petersoninstitute.org/t/94984/3351481/1906/0/ "Ed Truman") reviews some of the issues surrounding the growth of sovereign wealth funds, including Australia’s Future Fund, noting that:

> *Large cross-border holdings in official hands are at sharp variance with today’s general conception of a market-based global economy and financial system in which decision making is largely in the hands of numerous private agents pursuing commercial objectives.*
